subject: Qualification
notes: kb/Work PB919, wave 57. The 8.4.2.2.2 Format 3 qualified-index-name 'index-name-1 [data-qualifier]... [file-report-qualifier]' is accepted in every position that admits an index-name - SET, PERFORM/SEARCH VARYING, a relation condition, a subscript - with the qualifier chain starting AT the table (SR6: 'may include the name of the table with which the index-name is associated, as well as any name by which that table may be qualified'), IN and OF equivalent (SR3). A qualifier that names no declaring table is COBOL1639 citing SR6. Before: every qualified form was 'not defined'.
